learned: 2026-10-05, agent pass: the sitemap lists 195 /flavor/<slug> detail pages for all of Kiva Confections' brands (Kiva, Camino, Lost Farm, Petra, Terra, KIVA CBN Dream Team); 34 list NY: 18 Camino, 8 Kiva chocolate bars, 8 Lost Farm gummies.
notes: Stores list the whole Kiva Confections family under 'Kiva' ('KIVA LOST FARM - Gummies - ...', 'Edible Gummies | Camino | Watermelon Spritz Sours'). Since 2026-10-05 this catalog takes only Kiva's own products (the chocolate bars): Camino and Lost Farm have their own recipes, and import moves a 'Kiva' listing that names the sub-brand to it. Before, this catalog held a second copy of 20 Camino products, modelled differently from Camino's.

One product per detail page (/flavor/<slug>). New York is the 'Available in:' market list (.kv-pdp-market); the cards on /products cap that list at five codes and hide NY, so they cannot be the source. The breadcrumb ('Products | Camino | Sour Gummies') gives the sub-brand and format.

Kiva's own bars are named flavour + chocolate base ('Churro Milk Chocolate', 'Midnight Mint Dark Chocolate CBN', plain 'Dark Chocolate'): the base is the line and the flavour the strain, so stores' 'Churro' and 'Milk Chocolate Churro' both find it. 'Limited Edition' and the cannabinoid suffix (CBN, CBD 1:1) are dropped.

Size: the stats give THC per serving and usually per pack, the Product Information list gives servings per package. Each size rule needs the per-serving dose plus a matching per-pack figure or servings count: 5mg -> 20pk 100mg, 10mg -> 10pk 100mg, Camino's 2mg Sparkling Pear 20pk 40mg. Forest Berry's page says 200mg per pack but 10 servings of 10mg, and NY caps a package at 100mg; NY stores sell it as 10pk 100mg. Any other dose falls through to unparsed on purpose.

'High Dose' pages are skipped: Camino's Blackberry Dream High Dose is 200mg a pack, over NY's cap, and 'High Dose Blackberry Dark Chocolate' is a Michigan page (slug ...-mi) that lists NY while the regular Blackberry bar lists only CA and IL.

skip.why: Camino and Lost Farm keep their own catalogs (camino.json, lost-farm.json); a store's 'KIVA Camino ...' listing moves to the sub-brand at import (brand_aliases.json _sub_brands)
high dose: over New York's 100mg package cap, or another state's page

when.meta: (?=.*THC per serving 5mg\b)(?=.*(?:THC per pack 100mg\b|Servings Per Package:\s*20\b))
